payloads.description: Fetch /swagger.json to determine API surface exposure. needs_observation=true until response captured.

prerequisites.description: Capture response body of /swagger.json for analysis of exposed endpoints and schemas.

test_cases.notes: Discovery first: retrieving API spec to inform subsequent authenticated tests and parameter lists. Stop if 200 response contains sensitive schemas or auth endpoints.

payloads.description: Baseline request using observed sample value for comparison.
Reflected XSS probe: inject script tag into 'user' query parameter to detect reflection in HTML response or change in body length.

prerequisites.description: No authentication required; ensure no session cookies are attached.

oracle_rules.condition: response body contains literal "<script>alert(1)</script>" OR response body length changes by >=10% compared to baseline
status code differs from baseline or is in [400,500]

test_cases.notes: Run baseline first, then probe. If discovery test (tc-h9-001) reveals additional auth or CSP headers, pause and re-evaluate payloads.

payloads.description: Unauthenticated baseline fetch of /all_users/ for size comparison.
Authenticated fetch required — needs_observation=true. Authenticate as alternative user and compare responses.

prerequisites.description: Observe responses in both unauthenticated and authenticated contexts; capture body lengths and status codes.
prerequisites.custom_logic: Set needs_observation=true until authenticated and unauthenticated responses are captured

oracle_rules.condition: Response body length differs by >=50% between contexts (unauthenticated vs authenticated) OR returned JSON user count changes by >=50%
Status code differs across contexts (e.g., 200 vs 401/403)

test_cases.notes: Run unauthenticated baseline first. If tc-h9-001 reveals auth endpoints or token flows, obtain test credentials and re-run authenticated probe. Stop if 401/403 observed.

payloads.description: Authenticated request as different user to compare monetary data exposure.

prerequisites.description: Capture responses for unauthenticated and authenticated users; mark needs_observation until both captured.
prerequisites.custom_logic: Ensure inclusion of authentication tokens in authenticated request

oracle_rules.condition: Response body length or numeric monetary fields differ by >=20% between contexts

test_cases.notes: Defer until tc-h9-001 reveals auth flows. If unauthenticated returns sensitive numeric fields, escalate priority and capture exact JSON keys.

payloads.description: Baseline valid file upload to observe normal server behavior.

payloads.value: PNG with benign text payload referencing example.com/callback

payloads.description: Upload benign image-like file containing a URL to detect server-side fetching or processing. Monitor for OOB interactions and error signatures.

prerequisites.description: If CSRF token required, extract beforehand; otherwise proceed unauthenticated. Track any cookies returned.
prerequisites.custom_logic: Set needs_observation=true if CSRF presence unknown

oracle_rules.condition: Server returns 4xx/5xx or response contains stack trace or error indicators after crafted file upload
Out-of-band DNS/HTTP callback observed to attacker-controlled domain embedded in uploaded file

test_cases.notes: Run baseline upload first. Monitor returned cookies and response headers for CSRF or upload-processing indicators. Abort if server returns 4xx/5xx repeatedly.
